definitions.explanation: The part of the body at the end of the arm, used for grasping.
The entire upper limb from shoulder to hand.

examples.japanese: {右手|みぎて}と{左手|ひだりて}。
examples.english: The right hand and the left hand.

examples.japanese: {手|て}が{冷|つめ}たくなりました。
{彼女|かのじょ}は{手|て}で{顔|かお}を{隠|かく}して、{泣|な}いていました。
examples.english: She was crying, covering her face with her hands.

examples.japanese: {手|て}が{長|なが}い{人|ひと}です。
examples.english: They're a person with long arms.

examples.japanese: {赤|あか}ちゃんの{手|て}は{小|ちい}さいです。
{棚|たな}に{手|て}が{届|とど}かないので、{椅子|いす}を{使|つか}いました。
examples.english: I couldn't reach the shelf with my arm, so I used a chair.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{手|て}を{広|ひろ}げて、「これくらいの{大|おお}きさでした」と{言|い}いました。
examples.english: He spread his arms and said, "It was about this big."

notes:
{手|て} is a highly versatile word meaning both hand and arm, used in many expressions and compounds.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {手|て}を{洗|あら}う: to wash hands
- {手|て}を{上|あ}げる: to raise one's hand
- {手|て}を{伸|の}ばす: to reach out
- {手|て}が{届|とど}く: to be able to reach
- {手|て}を{貸|か}す: to lend a hand, help

COMPOUND WORDS:
- {右手|みぎて}: right hand
- {左手|ひだりて}: left hand
- {手伝|てつだ}う: to help
- {手紙|てがみ}: letter

RELATED:
- {指|ゆび}: finger
- {腕|うで}: arm (more specific term)
